_comment: The AI assistant's own application-written lines (chat_agent.py, chat_api.py) — the replies and wait labels the CODE writes, never the model. Server-rendered only, so this namespace is never shipped to a browser.
assistant.action_needs_login: No appointment was requested: to request one, you need to log in.
assistant.action_not_done: That request did not go through: no appointment was requested or cancelled.
assistant.coverage_unknown: I do not have a verified source on what that coverage includes, so I cannot confirm it. Please check with your health insurance, prepaid plan or program.
assistant.daily_limit: You have reached today's limit of assistant messages. You can keep going from the {brand} service and centre pages.
assistant.emergency: If this is an emergency, do not wait for this chat: call {number} now or go to the nearest emergency department.
assistant.emergency_no_number: If this is an emergency, do not wait for this chat: call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
assistant.out_of_scope: I can only help you with appointments, services and health centres of the {network}. You can search for a specialty or a centre.
assistant.rate_limited: You sent several messages in a row. Wait a little and write again.
assistant.rephrase: Could you say that another way?
assistant.route.heading: Next available appointments:
assistant.route.no_order: You do not need a medical order for this first appointment.
assistant.route.open_service: Open the linked service to see its next appointments.
assistant.route.referral_intro: **{specialty}** is the right specialty. A medical referral is required in this network, so start with **{gateway}**.
assistant.too_many_steps: I could not work this out in a few steps — try rewording the request, or keep going on the website.
assistant.unavailable: We can't answer by chat right now. See the schedules and book your appointment in {services}; the details of each site are in {centers}.
